Extract fitted prior values

Source: R/07_mpcurve.R
fitted_prior.Rd

Extracts the fitted probability distribution over sample positions or feature orderings. Position probabilities \(\pi_k\) describe the population distribution across the latent grid. Partition probabilities \(\omega_m\) describe the relative prevalence of the orderings among features. These are the priors used to calculate sample-specific position responsibilities and feature-specific assignment probabilities.

Single-ordering position priors are length-K vectors. Multi-ordering fits return a named list of M such vectors unless a specific ordering is requested. For partition priors, ordering = NULL returns the full prior record, including the prior mode and effective \(\omega\) vector; a specific ordering returns the corresponding scalar \(\omega_m\) mass.

Usage

fitted_prior(x, type = c("position", "partition"), ordering = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mpcurve'
fitted_prior(x, type = c("position", "partition"), ordering = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'cavi'
fitted_prior(x, type = c("position", "partition"), ordering = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'soft_partition_cavi'
fitted_prior(x, type = c("position", "partition"), ordering = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted mpcurve, raw cavi, or raw structural soft_partition_cavi object.

type

One of "position" or "partition".

ordering

Optional ordering label or 1-based ordering index. For a single-ordering position prior it may identify the sole ordering; for a partition fit use the labels in names(x$locations).

...

Unused.

Value

If type = "position", a numeric vector for a single-ordering fit, a named list of vectors for an unfiltered partition fit, or one numeric vector when ordering is supplied. If type = "partition", NULL for a single-ordering fit, the full partition-prior record when ordering = NULL, or one unnamed numeric mass when an ordering is supplied.
